classification.difficultyReason: The rectangle's diagonal must be seen as the hypotenuse, then a missing side found by subtraction and left as a surd. One extra recognition step over p21-q3.

content.prompt: Find the length of the unknown side of this rectangle. Leave your answer in exact form.

answer.worked:
The diagonal is the hypotenuse of the right-angled triangle.
$$\begin{align*}a^2+b^2&=h^2\\x^2+11^2&=14^2\\x^2&=196-121\\x^2&=75\\x&=\sqrt{75}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
